english.title: Possess a loaded / unloaded air weapon in a public place
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, had with you in a public place, namely **(..SPECIFY PUBLIC PLACE..), a

(A)_[a loaded air weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY AIR WEAPON..)]_
(B)_[an unloaded air weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY AIR WEAPON..)]_
(C)_[an air weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY AIR WEAPON..), whether loaded or not]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section19 of, and Schedule6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority/reasonable excuse
had a loaded/unloaded air weapon/imitation firearm in a public place

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See also offence wordings: H493 and H494.
(ii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).
(iii) See also Home Office Guidance on Firearms Licensing Law.
